UI Atlas fixture site

Controlled pages for inspector, state, settle and identity tests.

  • States — hover, focus, active, checked, expanded, disabled
  • Identity — locator candidate coverage
  • Settle — lazy images, fonts, endless requests, sticky header
  • Shadow DOM — open and closed roots
  • Frames — same-origin and cross-origin iframes
  • Hostile CSS — aggressive globals and high z-index overlays
  • SPA — route changes and DOM replacement
  • Motion — transitions, animations, Web Animations
  • Responsive — layout decided at initial load
  • Media — canvas, WebGL and video limitations
  • Destructive — controls that must never be auto-clicked
